title: Notification configuration
description: Create rules that decide which notification channels are sent to each role.

channels.label: Channels
channels.description: Select at least one channel. System notifications are shown in the in-app bell.

roleIds.label: Recipient roles
roleIds.description: Select one or more roles. Event handlers can still narrow recipients to the exact assigned users.

active.label: Active
active.description: Inactive configs do not create or emit notifications.

channelDescriptions.system: Show in the notification bell for target users.
channelDescriptions.email: Send email when sender configuration is ready.

rolesMeta.noActiveUsers: No active users. Saving is allowed but a warning is shown.

OCR_COMPLETED.label: OCR completed
OCR_COMPLETED.description: Notify when a dossier has finished OCR processing.

DOSSIER_ASSIGNED.label: New assignment
DOSSIER_ASSIGNED.description: Notify assigned handlers when a new dossier assignment is created.

EDITORS_COMPLETED.label: Editors completed — waiting QC
EDITORS_COMPLETED.description: When all editors finish, notify the assigned QC.

QC_STEP_COMPLETED.label: Previous QC step completed
QC_STEP_COMPLETED.description: When a QC round is approved, notify the next QC step.

DOSSIER_APPROVED.label: Dossier approved
DOSSIER_APPROVED.description: When a dossier is APPROVED, notify the project manager.
